title: purple-mimi 8: packaging and release (Linux, Homebrew macOS)
description: §10 and §13 step 8: release tarballs with .so files for x86_64 and aarch64 Linux, a source tarball with vendored crates, a Homebrew tap formula against Homebrew's pidgin (libpurple 2 only), GPL-3.0-or-later COPYING, mimid's NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES from cargo-about, cargo-deny licence check, README (keys in the Pidgin process, one provider token per Pidgin, shared BitlBee hosts). Windows is mimid-s4oy.11. Announce only with Mark's OK.
